description: RENDERS an AI Video Story episode into its final delivered file (stage 3 of 3), after the scene videos are done. It is composed SERVER-side from the stored episode (scenes, captions, music, title card, watermark policy); you pass only the episode id. WHEN: `get_video` shows `succeeded` or `story.stage: "ready_to_render"` (an episode edited in the web editor renders with those edits; a later render replaces the file). AFTER: the answer carries `render_id` and `story.stage: "rendering"`; how to wait and which url to hand over when (`story.render.url` once `rendered`, never the raw preview before): `story-episode` recipe, step 9. `story.render.status: "failed"` means it failed and was refunded: ask before rendering again. A repeat during a render answers the SAME `render_id` with `coalesced: true`: not a failure. COST: per rendered minute at the platform render rate, from the episode's own duration. `estimate_only: true` works only once the episode is renderable (before then it refuses and names the stage); earlier, give `pricing.render_tokens_per_minute` (series' full `list_series` entry) as a rate or a tilde figure, never as the price. THE GO THIS ONE NEEDS: a render is its own charge and ask; approving the scene videos or saying the episode looks good is not a go to render. The user must name rendering or the final file, and a bare 'yes' counts only as the direct answer to your priced render ask. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, state the price in the same message as your ask, wait for a go naming THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES: `get_recipe` `spending-rules`). `idempotency_key`: IDEMPOTENCY (this server's instructions).
name: render_story_video
title: Render a story episode (the final file)
